assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Trirectangular tetrahedron OABC drawn in perspective with O behind face ABC: dashed edges OA = p, OB = q, OC = r, the foot H on AB with dashed OH, and the solid altitude CH of face ABC.

difficulty_rationale: Part (a) needs the three-perpendiculars argument in space; part (b) needs the idea of choosing the face areas first and an identity making X^2 + Y^2 + Z^2 a square.
